SELECT /* isry.couns.constt.bbsonm.mapper.BbsonmListMapper.getTotalCount : 실시간게시판 게시글수 */ COUNT(*) FROM AYE100 WHERE 1=1 AND BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = #{BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD} /* 게시글유형구분코드 */ AND ( DEL_YN != 'Y' OR DEL_YN IS NULL )
AND FRST_RGTR_ID LIKE '%'|| #{SEARCH_DATA} || '%'
AND C##RG.DEC_B64(WRTR_NM_ENCPT) LIKE '%'|| #{SEARCH_DATA} || '%'
AND BBSCTT_CN LIKE '%'|| #{SEARCH_DATA} || '%'

SELECT /* isry.couns.constt.bbsonm.mapper.BbsonmListMapper.selectBbsonmList : 실시간게시판 게시글목록 */ BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO /* 게시글고유번호 */ , C##RG.DEC_B64(WRTR_NM_ENCPT) AS WRTR_NM_ENCPT /* 성함 */ , FRST_RGTR_ID AS WRTR_ID /* 아이디 */ , TO_CHAR(LAST_MDFCN_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD hh:mm:ss') AS CRT_DT /* 등록일자 */ , BBSCTT_CN /* 게시글내용 */ , COUNT(*) OVER() AS TOTAL_COUNT FROM AYE100 WHERE 1=1 AND BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = #{BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD} /* 게시글유형구분코드 */ AND ( DEL_YN != 'Y' OR DEL_YN IS NULL )
AND FRST_RGTR_ID LIKE '%'|| #{SEARCH_DATA} || '%'
AND C##RG.DEC_B64(WRTR_NM_ENCPT) LIKE '%'|| #{SEARCH_DATA} || '%'
AND BBSCTT_CN LIKE '%'|| #{SEARCH_DATA} || '%'
ORDER BY BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO DESC OFFSET #{START_IDX} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{ROW_COUNT} ROWS ONLY
mapper.insert: INSERT /* isry.couns.constt.bbsonm.mapper.BbsonmListMapper.insertBbsonm : 실시간게시판 게시글등록 */ INTO AYE100 ( BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO /* 게시글 고유번호 */ , BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD /* 게시글 유형구분 코드 */ , WRTR_NM_ENCPT /* 작성자명 */ , BBSCTT_CN /* 게시글내용 */ , FRST_RGTR_ID /* 최초등록자아이디 */ , FRST_REG_DT /* 최초등록일시 */ , LAST_MDFR_ID /* 최종수정자아이디 */ , LAST_MDFCN_DT /* 최종수정일시 */ ) VALUES ( ( SELECT NVL(MAX(BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO),0) +1 FROM AYE100 WHERE BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = #{BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD} ) , #{BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD} /* 게시글 유형구분 코드 */ , C##RG.ENC_B64(#{WRTR_NM_ENCPT}) , #{BBSCTT_CN} , #{FRST_RGTR_ID} , SYSDATE , #{LAST_MDFR_ID} , SYSDATE )
mapper.update: UPDATE /* isry.couns.constt.bbsonm.mapper.BbsonmListMapper.deleteBbsonm : 실시간게시판 게시글삭제 */ AYE100 SET DEL_YN = 'Y' , LAST_MDFCN_DT = SYSDATE , LAST_MDFR_ID = #{LAST_MDFR_ID} WHERE 1=1 AND BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO = #{BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO} AND BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = #{BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD} /*게시글 유형구분 코드*/
